bagPolicy.summary: Bags must not exceed 12” x 6” x 12”. Small clutch bags up to 6"x9" are allowed. Backpacks and multi-compartment bags are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: There are various parking decks available around The Battery, with the Orange and Delta decks being the closest to the venue. On Braves game days, parking availability may vary.

rideshare.note: Use The Battery Atlanta rideshare zone along Windy Ridge Parkway for drop-off.

concessions.note: Coca-Cola Roxy offers a variety of late-night bites including classic options like fries, hot dogs, and grilled cheese, as well as specialty items such as a Smash Burger and Crispy Chicken Po'Boy. The EP Lounge features exclusive dishes like Braised Short Rib Hoagie and Jack and Coke Glazed Pork Belly. The kitchen closes at 9:00 PM.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Limited storage is available for wheelchairs, canes, walkers, and other mobility devices. Coca-Cola Roxy's Accessible section on the floor is located in front of the stage on the right side of the venue.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The box office is open on show days only, starting 2 hours before general door time, and hours can change. For ticket upgrades, exchanges, or availability, contact the box office at 470.351.3866 or cocacolaroxyinfo@livenation.com.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Coca-Cola Roxy has General and Premium main entrances, and both are fully accessible. For the balcony, staff can direct you to the elevator in the main room on the first level. Door times vary by event, so check your event page.
